decisions.reason: The About page currently presents Aave integration and Aave-backed yield generation as active product features, which necessarily becomes inaccurate when the integration is removed entirely.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: That works, so we’ll remove the Aave integration entirely.

technology_copy.heading: Chainlink VRF
technology_copy.body: Random prize-draw selection that is provably fair.

technology_copy.heading: Base Network
technology_copy.body: Fast transactions and low fees, supported by Ethereum security.

technology_copy.heading: Decentralized
technology_copy.body: All logic is fully on-chain from day one, while V1 includes initial safeguards. Battle-testing will guide the evolution to full decentralization.

technology_copy.heading: Secure
technology_copy.body: Uses industry-leading protocols and best practices.

key_features_copy: Automatic Rewards: Smart contracts issue all payments instantly.
Fair Prize Selection: Chainlink VRF provides genuine randomness.
Gamification: Badges and leaderboards keep the experience fun and competitive.
Transparency: Every transaction and rule is on-chain and verifiable.
Low Fees: Base provides speed with minimal transaction costs.

decisions.reason: Removing the Aave yield integration does not change automatic prize transfers or winner announcements.
Chainlink VRF winner selection is independent of whether prize-pool deposits generate Aave yield.
The Aave removal does not alter Big Block ticket issuance, eligibility, weighting, or reset behavior.
The Aave removal does not alter Small Block ticket issuance, eligibility, weighting, or reset behavior.
Removing yield generation does not itself change the Small Block prize amount, cadence, qualifying sales, or pool funding.
Removing yield generation does not itself change the Big Block winner count, prize amount, or sales-count trigger.
Primary-sale proceeds can continue funding the prize pools without depositing those funds into Aave; no allocation change is entailed.
The direct referral commission amount, trigger, recipient, and payout behavior are independent of Aave yield generation.
Secondary royalties may continue funding prize pools even though those pools no longer use Aave to generate yield.
The Transak fiat conversion and mint flow is unrelated to the removed Aave prize-pool integration.
Brevo transactional email delivery is unrelated to the removed Aave prize-pool integration.
